name: deoptkit-vscode
description: V8 deoptimization findings from deoptkit (megamorphic inline caches, deopt loops, hidden-class churn) as inline diagnostics
author: Drake Costa <drake@saeris.gg> (https://saeris.gg)

deoptkit.findingsPath.description: The findings interchange written by `deoptkit ci` or the deoptkit/vitest preset, relative to the workspace folder.

deoptkit.serverCommand.description: Command that starts the language server, e.g. ["npx", "deoptkit", "lsp"]. Leave empty to use the workspace's installed deoptkit, or the server bundled with this extension when there is none.

scripts.build: vp pack && vp exec vsce package --no-dependencies
